title: Sidra Glow Studio — Skincare & Beauty Studio
tagline: A skincare shop with online studio bookings, fully working in your browser
description: The customer side of Sidra Glow Studio, a skincare shop and beauty-treatment studio in Tangail: filter by skin type and concern, ingredient lists and best-before dates on every product, a skin quiz that builds a routine within your budget, routine sets, and facials you can book online for a free time slot. This is the shop's real code running in the browser — orders and bookings you make here appear in the Sidra Glow Studio admin demo.
highlights: Skin quiz → a routine from products in stock, within your budget
Book a facial: pick a day and a free time, get a booking number
Checkout fills Division → District → Upazila with a live delivery fee by zone
Phone check at checkout: the SMS code appears on screen in the demo
Every confirmed order gets an invoice number and a PDF invoice
Coupons GLOW100 and ROUTINE10 work at checkout
Orders you place show up in the admin demo — it is one working system
Optional shopper sign-in: 01700000001 / demo12345 — nothing is charged or delivered, and ?demo-reset starts fresh

admin.note: Opens signed in (demo / demo12345). Orders you place in the shop appear here.
